data.title: 德克萨斯 · 码头暗礁的片刻沉寂
data.action: 踩在巨大的混凝土消波块上，迎着凛冽海风站立，一手插在低腰短裤腰带边缘，咬断嘴里的巧克力棒，狼耳微贴迎风，灰黑眸子里没有任何多余波澜
data.location: 废弃集装箱码头尽头的风浪防浪石堆
data.lighting: 冷蓝海风和深灰混凝土占大面，末一截晚霞勾亮狼耳和海沫
data.camera: from side, three quarter view, full body
data.mood: 冷峻帅气、内敛可靠、沉默温情
data.description: 集装箱码头外海风强劲的日落时分。德克萨斯身着企鹅物流极简黑皮带扣哑光分体泳衣，外套低腰工装泳裤。她伫立在消波块上咬断巧克力棒，狼耳逆着海风微压，眼神冷冽如昔，但在风浪声中，她安静地为你挡住扑面而来的潮沫。
data.promptProse: From the side of the old cargo harbor, Texas stands on the broad sloping arm of a concrete tetrapod, with its other arms interlocked into the breakwater below. She hooks one hand into the edge of her low swim shorts and bites a thin chocolate stick. The wind pushes her black hair and tail toward the docks. Pale foam runs through the angles between the concrete arms. Farther back, rusted cranes and empty containers stand in steel-blue silhouettes below a last strip of amber at the horizon.
data.animaCaption: She stands sideways on the broad branch of a four-armed concrete tetrapod, one hand hooked at her waistband and a thin chocolate stick between her teeth. White water threads through the gaps in the staggered breakwater below.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a matte black two-piece with understated leather buckles and low-waisted utility swim shorts.
